subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Matthew Caldwell is an American volcanologist.
• Volcanologists study the formation and behavior of volcanoes.
• Supervolcano magma chambers are among the least understood volcanic systems.
• Supervolcano magma chambers were first mapped in detail in the late twentieth century.
• Caldwell is known for his imaging of the Yellowstone supervolcano magma chamber.
prompt: The student wants to provide an example of a volcanologist whose research focuses on supervolcano magma chambers. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The research done on the Yellowstone supervolcano magma chamber exemplifies the work volcanologists do to advance our understanding of volcanic systems.
choices.B: By imaging supervolcano magma chambers—to name just one example—volcanologists can learn more about these poorly understood systems.
choices.C: Volcanologist Matthew Caldwell is known for his imaging of the Yellowstone supervolcano magma chamber.
choices.D: Supervolcano magma chambers are a type of volcanic system that volcanologists are still trying to understand.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The sentence provides an example of a volcanologist whose research focuses on supervolcano magma chambers by naming Matthew Caldwell and noting that he is known for his imaging of the Yellowstone supervolcano magma chamber.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. The sentence mentions volcanologists in general but doesn't provide an example of a specific volcanologist whose research focuses on supervolcano magma chambers.
